# Product Requirements Document

## Feature

Music events management and presentation in the Umbraco solution.

## Problem Statement

The current site has no dedicated editorial workflow for publishing music events and no branded frontend presentation for upcoming events.

## Goal

Allow backoffice editors to create and manage music events, then present them on the website with strong visual design and smooth animation.

## Primary Users

- Backoffice editors managing event information.
- Website visitors browsing upcoming music events.

## PoC Scope

- Create an editor-friendly event model in Umbraco.
- Support the core event fields needed to publish an event.
- Render a public-facing events experience with elevated visual design.
- Add tasteful animation and transitions to the frontend experience.

## Out Of Scope

- Ticket purchasing flows.
- Calendar synchronization with external systems.
- Advanced search, filtering, or personalization.
- Multi-step event approval workflows.

## Success Criteria

- Editors can create a new event without developer help.
- Events appear correctly on the website after publishing.
- The frontend looks intentionally designed rather than default Umbraco output.
- The animation layer feels smooth and not distracting.
